Our story

From a quarry visit to a studio

Lithen was founded by a small team of sculptors and horticulturists who wanted to combine two disappearing crafts — stone carving and moss preservation — into pieces built for modern interiors.

Every piece that leaves our studio is still made the same way the first one was: sourced by hand, carved by hand, and installed by hand.

The process

From quarry to living room

Four stages, each done by hand. See the full process →

01

Source

Stone quarried and moss harvested from renewable, managed sources.

02

Preserve

Moss is stabilised through a natural process that keeps it soft and green.

03

Sculpt

Artisans carve and layer each stone form by hand — no two alike.

04

Install

Our team fits the piece on site and sets up ambient lighting around it.
